_meta.rule: Each entry: value (triangular min/mode/max or scalar), source, source_date, next_update (when the source next publishes), trigger (what would move it), maps_to (model parameter).

capex_history.source: Epoch AI (2023-25); 2026 = Q3-call guidance (unchanged in total): GOOG 195-205 (unchanged, 8-K/call 2026-10-28), MSFT ~170 calendar-2026 (down from ~175; year attribution reported, not verified verbatim), AMZN ~220 cash (8-K 2026-10-29), META 135-145 incl. finance-lease principal (8-K 2026-10-21), ORCL ~50

q3_2026_quarter.note: definitions differ by company; Q3 four-company total ~209

capex_history.direction_2027: GOOG: 'expect our capex to increase significantly in 2027' (no number; '$300B' is press estimate, not guidance); AMZN: 'spend meaningfully more in 2027'; META: 'continue investing aggressively'; MSFT: FY27 capex to grow y/y, Q2 FY27 >$50B; ORCL (Investor Day 2026-10-28, 8-K): 'peak capex in FY27-FY28 ... step-down in FY29'

life_training.source: thermal physics (JEDEC JEP122, Llama-3 field data)

anchors.msft_q1fy27: ~3/4 of Microsoft Q1 FY27 capex was short-lived assets, primarily CPUs and GPUs (CFO, call 2026-10-28)

anchors.msft_accounting_2026-07: Microsoft lengthened data-center building lives from 15 to 25 years from FY27 (CFO Dive 2026-07-30) - accounting choice; lowers reported depreciation, not economic carry. Paper keeps 15/20/25.
anchors.msft_leases_2026-07: Microsoft now books new data-center leases as operating rather than finance leases, lowering reported capex vs the Epoch series definition

opex_share.source: decomposed: PUE, tariff (EIA), utilization, staff, tax, network
opex_share.flag: disputed input (v27): Goldman Sachs/Epoch use $836M per GW-yr non-D&A opex, ~2% of capital (power and maintenance only). Paper decomposition adds staffing, property tax/insurance, network, other = 6.65%. Gap ~$85-115B/yr of carry 2028-30. Adopting 0.02 would be a MATERIAL re-issue (|dz|>=0.5); not adopted pending a sourced operator cost per MW-year.

inflation.source: Min: Federal Reserve longer-run 2% PCE inflation goal; mode: US core CPI 2.6% y/y, Sep 2026 (BLS, released 2026-10-14); max: US headline CPI 3.7% y/y, Sep 2026 (BLS)
inflation.note: Presentation only (real returns, deficits in 2026 dollars). Not applied to receipts (contracts fixed in nominal dollars; AI unit prices falling; ceilings built from today's prices) and not applied again to the payback test, because the WACC is already nominal.

grid_cap.flag: high anchor (v27): Goldman Sachs semiconductor build implies 20/35/57 GW of AI deployments in 2026/27/28 (all buyers); 57 GW is above this range top (40 GW/yr). Observable to test in 2028 energization data.

reissue_rule.minor: any input change: rerun, update tables, bump version, no re-release
reissue_rule.material: |delta z_2030| >= 0.5 OR |delta g*_2030| >= 5 points OR P(profit 2030, rationalize) moves >= 15 points OR any 2026 observable outside its P10-P90 -> re-release with a delta log
reissue_rule.cadence: after each Big-5 earnings week (late Jan, late Apr, late Jul, late Oct) and after Nvidia (Feb/May/Aug/Nov)
